title: Finite etale extension from a fibrewise dense open over a depth-two local base
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring with closed point a in Spec A [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let q:L → Spec A be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and U an open of L [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Assume every point of L not lying over a belongs to U, and the inverse image of U in the scheme-theoretic fibre L_a is dense [def-pc-fibre-product]. If depth A ≥ 2 [def-weil-pbc-depth], then every finite etale morphism f:X → U [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism] extends: there are E, a finite etale p:E → L, and an isomorphism e:E|_U ≅ X over U, satisfying e;f = p|_U. No domain, normality, geometric connectedness, quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness of q is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0EYB (Lemma 58.26.3), 0EY6 (Lemma 58.21.5), 0337; proof of step 2 of lem-sbc-finite-normal-depth-two-purity

proof.text: The whole fibre at every s different from a lies in U, by haway. At a its inverse image is dense by hclosed. Therefore U is dense in each fibre. The stalk of Spec A at its closed point is canonically A, so depth A ≥ 2 ensures that a is not a point of base depth at most one. At every base point of depth at most one the whole fibre is in U.

Apply the extension argument of Tag 0EYB. Its depth test follows from the flat local depth formula 0337: outside U the total-space stalk has depth at least two. Construct the extension as the relative spectrum of the pushforward of f_* O_X, as in 0EY6; it is a finite algebra, reflexive as a module, and its formation commutes with flat base change. To check etaleness, enlarge U to the etale locus and suppose its complement is nonempty. Choose a base point minimal under generalization in its image, localize there, and choose a closed point of the complement in that fibre. A finite flat base change realizes its residue field, then an etale local slice provides a section through that point. Completing an affine smooth chart at the section gives A[[x_1,...,x_d]]. Fibrewise density forces d > 0 and puts the generic point of the special fibre in U. The power-series purity calculation (0EYA, Lemma 58.26.2) makes the base-changed extension etale. Flat descent contradicts membership of the chosen point in the complement. Thus the extension p is etale everywhere. Its restriction to U is f by construction, yielding e and its equation.

theorem exists_finite_etale_extension_of_local_depth_two
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Smooth q]
    (U : L.Opens)
    (haway : ∀ y : L, q y ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A → y ∈ U)
    (hclosed : Dense (↑((q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
      Set (q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A))))
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] :
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ L), IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ≅ X, e.hom ≫ f = p ∣_ U
